description: This file defines a PHP class 'Register' within the Opencart system, specifically in the checkout process. It handles the registration part of the checkout workflow, including rendering the registration view and saving registration data. The class extends a base Controller class and interacts with various models and configuration settings to manage customer registration, address information, captcha validation, and form processing.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class handling the registration process during checkout in Opencart. Manages rendering registration page and processing registration data submissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the registration view for checkout, preparing data including language strings, customer groups, addresses, and captcha components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the registration data submitted by the user during checkout, including validation, session management, and redirection.
